# tessell_parameter_profile (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a PostgreSQL parameter profile with custom parameter values
resource "tessell_parameter_profile" "example" {
  name        = "my-postgres-profile"
  description = "Custom PostgreSQL parameter profile"
  engine_type = "POSTGRESQL"
  db_version  = "16"

  engine_info {
    edition = "COMMUNITY"
  }

  parameters {
    name  = "max_connections"
    value = "600"
  }

  parameters {
    name  = "work_mem"
    value = "8192"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `db_version` (String) Database Engine version
- `engine_type` (String) Database Engine type (e.g., POSTGRESQL, MYSQL, ORACLE, etc.)
- `name` (String) Name of the Parameter Profile

### Optional

- `description` (String) Database Parameter Profile description
- `engine_info` (Block List, Max: 1) Database engine specific info (required for some engine types like PostgreSQL) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--engine_info))
- `infra_type` (String) Infrastructure type (e.g., AWS, AZURE, GCP)
- `maturity_status` (String) Action to change the maturity status of the Parameter Profile. Allowed values: `draft`, `publish`, `unpublish`.
- `parameters` (Block List) Parameters to manage in this profile. State stores all parameters returned by the API (for accurate import). Only changes to parameters declared here are planned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--parameters))
- `propagation_policy` (Block List, Max: 1) Update propagation policy. If not provided, the API will handle defaults. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--propagation_policy))
- `source_parameter_profile_id` (String) ID of the parameter profile to duplicate from

### Read-Only

- `date_created` (String) Timestamp when the entity was created
- `date_modified` (String) Timestamp when the entity was last modified
- `driver_info` (List of Object) Driver information (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--driver_info))
- `factory_parameter_id` (String) Tessell parameter type UUID for the entity
- `id` (String) Tessell generated UUID for the entity
- `is_legacy` (Boolean) Whether this Parameter Profile is Legacy or not
- `metadata` (List of Object) Parameter profile metadata (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `oob` (Boolean) Out of box parameter profile
- `owner` (String) Owner of the Parameter Profile
- `status` (String) Status of the Parameter Profile
- `user_id` (String) Database Parameter Profile's user id
- `version_id` (String) Tessell generated UUID for the entity version

<a id="nestedblock--engine_info"></a>
### Nested Schema for `engine_info`

Optional:

- `edition` (String) Engine edition (e.g., COMMUNITY for PostgreSQL)
- `oracle` (Block List, Max: 1) Oracle specific engine info parameters (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--engine_info--oracle))

<a id="nestedblock--engine_info--oracle"></a>
### Nested Schema for `engine_info.oracle`

Optional:

- `multi_tenancy` (String) Oracle multi-tenancy mode (CDB or NON_CDB)

### Nested Schema for `parameters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Parameter name
- `value` (String) Parameter value

Read-Only:

- `allowed_values` (String) Allowed values for the parameter
- `apply_type` (String) Apply type (static/dynamic)
- `data_type` (String) Parameter data type
- `default_value` (String) Default value of the parameter
- `description` (String) Parameter description
- `is_formula_type` (Boolean) Whether the parameter is a formula type
- `is_modifiable` (Boolean) Whether the parameter is modifiable
- `is_modified` (Boolean) Whether the parameter value is modified from default
- `source` (String) Source of the parameter
- `top_parameter` (Boolean) Boolean variable indicating a parameter is a most modified / key parameter
- `usage_type` (String) Usage type of the parameter


<a id="nestedblock--propagation_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `propagation_policy`

Required:

- `strategy` (String) Update propagation strategy: IMMEDIATELY, MAINTENANCE_WINDOW, CUSTOM_DATE_TIME, DO_NOT_APPLY.

Optional:

- `time` (String) Propagation time, required when strategy is CUSTOM_DATE_TIME (e.g. 2026-05-15T10:00:00Z).
